records.context: Ordinary launches open Home; only an explicit restart restores the saved interface. Settings drafts live in the preference store rather than in a file. They hold the unsaved settings of every open module and are cleared on a clean exit, so a draft found at start-up means the previous processing session ended without closing.

records.source: Ordinary launches open Home; only an explicit restart restores the saved interface. Settings drafts live in the preference store rather than in a file. They hold the unsaved settings of every open module and are cleared on a clean exit, so a draft found at start-up means the previous run ended without closing.
records.translation: Los inicios normales abren Home; solo un reinicio explícito restaura la interfaz guardada. Los borradores de ajustes se guardan en las preferencias en vez de en un archivo. Contienen los ajustes sin guardar de todos los módulos abiertos y se borran al salir normalmente, de modo que encontrar un borrador al inicio indica que la sesión anterior terminó sin cerrarse.
